services.title: 2. Description and Scope of Services
services.intro: {appName} is a cloud-based business communication platform provider that offers access to:

items.messaging: Third-party Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) (including but not limited to WhatsApp Business API and Meta Platforms).
items.integration: Centralized messaging management systems (Omnichannel) and CRM integrations.
items.analytics: Data analytics services, message performance reporting, and delivery logs.
items.automation: Message automation features, template management, and interactive bots.

usage.title: 5. Acceptable Use Policy
usage.intro: You are strictly prohibited from using {appName} services for:

items.laws: Activities that violate the laws of the Republic of Indonesia or laws in the jurisdiction where you operate.
items.spam: Sending bulk messages (spam), promotional messages without explicit recipient consent (Opt-in), or messages that disturb the comfort of end-users.
items.harmful: Distributing harmful content, viruses, malware, pornographic material, gambling, or content containing hate speech or harassment.
items.interfere: Attempting to decompile, reverse engineer, or undermine the integrity of our server infrastructure.
items.reverse: Using automated scripts to extract data or manipulate the system without written permission.
